sections.geometryPrecheck: Official GPX has two track pieces. Track 1 runs Lilla Hycklinge toward the Nynäs/Humlenäs area for 10.318 km; track 2 runs from the Nynäs/Humlenäs cluster back toward the same end area for 5.667 km. Raw all-track concatenation creates a 4.37 km jump. Needs ordering/endpoint review.
Official GPX is one continuous track from Nynäs to Lönhult; computed length 20.623 km and no steps over 500 m.
Official GPX contains 10 track pieces. Piece lengths sum to about 20.46 km, but raw order creates large jumps. Needs sequencing and direction review before import.
Official GPX contains 10 track pieces. Piece lengths sum to about 17.62 km, but raw order creates large jumps. Needs sequencing and direction review before import.

Official GPX contains three tracks, with one short Mörtfors-side piece duplicated and a main piece apparently stored Stjärneberg-to-Mörtfors. Distance contradiction is significant; needs geometry and PDF cross-check.
Official GPX is one continuous track but appears stored Lilla Laxemar-to-Stjärneberg, reverse of written order. Computed length 18.407 km; no steps over 500 m.
Official GPX is one continuous track from Lilla Laxemar toward the Hällveberg/Hedvigsberg endpoint; computed length 21.612 km and no steps over 500 m.
Official GPX contains eight track pieces. Piece lengths sum to about 16.85 km, but raw order creates large jumps. Needs sequencing and Hällveberg/Hedvigsberg endpoint naming review.

distanceSummary.contradiction: Total distance varies between 152.8 km from current Naturkartan section distances, about 154 km from Döderhults rounded section descriptions, and 160 km from whole-trail overview pages.
distanceSummary.importPolicy: Use section-level distances from the selected canonical source during normalization; preserve source-specific distance notes and avoid forcing the section distances to sum to 160 km.

branchesLoopsAlternatesConnectors.description: Ostkustleden itself is a closed ring beginning and ending at Lilla Hycklinge.
Stage 7 official description says hikers can leave the route toward Figeholm for shops and then walk about 1 km along the road toward Oskarshamn until the marked trail crosses the road again.
branchesLoopsAlternatesConnectors.importHandling: Model as access/service metadata unless a later official geometry source explicitly includes it.

branchesLoopsAlternatesConnectors.description: Lönnebergaleden starts/connects near Eckerhult on Stage 2 and links Ostkustleden with Sevedeleden.
branchesLoopsAlternatesConnectors.importHandling: Connector only; do not merge into Ostkustleden section geometry.

branchesLoopsAlternatesConnectors.description: Tjustleden connects to Ostkustleden in the south; Tjustleden Stage 1 starts near Mörtfors.
branchesLoopsAlternatesConnectors.importHandling: Connector only; do not merge into Ostkustleden section geometry.

branchesLoopsAlternatesConnectors.description: No official ferry, rowboat, or mandatory bus-transfer break found in the Phase 1 overview. Bus/taxi access is described as transport support rather than a route segment.

overnightCabins.description: Each stage endpoint has an overnight cabin intended for Ostkustleden hikers. The cabins are open year-round, have simple standards, and require a small overnight fee. Groups over 10 people should contact the maintainer in advance.

toilets.description: The maintainer overview says six of the endpoint cabins have simple older dry toilets; individual section research must verify which endpoints currently have toilets and coordinates.

water.description: Water availability varies by cabin. Some cabins have wells or summer water, while Nynäs can run dry in late summer and may require lake water from Hummeln to be boiled. Individual section files must track reliability.

camping.description: The maintainer overview cites Swedish allemansrätten guidance and says one night of tenting on another person's land is allowed when done responsibly; tenting at cabins has a listed fee. Protected-area exceptions require section-level checks.

fire.description: No whole-trail fire policy beyond normal Swedish rules was found in Phase 1. Stage/cabin pages and protected-area rules need section-level verification.

dogs.description: No whole-trail dog rule was found in Phase 1. Apply Swedish protected-area leash rules where relevant and verify reserve-specific restrictions in section files.

hunting.description: Naturkartan stage pages currently show a hunting-season notice saying elk hunting takes place between October 8 and January 31, advising hikers to respect signs, wear bright clothing, stay on trails, and communicate with hunters if encountered.
hunting.currentnessNote: Confirm on each section page during section research because Naturkartan notices can be seasonal/currentness-dependent.

closures.description: No whole-trail closure found in Phase 1. Section-level currentness checks remain required.

officialMapAndGeometrySources.geometryCaveat: Several GPX files are not a single sequential line in written stage order. Treat GPX as an official source but not automatically navigation-grade until each section's track order and endpoint continuity are reviewed.

sourceContradictionsAndStaleRisks.details: Whole-trail sources say 160 km / 16 mil; current Naturkartan stage distances sum to 152.8 km; Döderhult rounded descriptions sum to about 154 km.
sourceContradictionsAndStaleRisks.risk: Medium for user-facing distance totals; low for section identity.
sourceContradictionsAndStaleRisks.recommendedHandling: Keep source-specific distances in research. At normalization, choose one distance policy and record computed geometry distances separately.

sourceContradictionsAndStaleRisks.details: Current display names use Hällveberg, while Naturkartan URLs use `hedvigsberg` for stages 7 and 8. Older/third-party sources may say Hedvigsberg.
sourceContradictionsAndStaleRisks.risk: Medium for stable IDs and search aliases.
sourceContradictionsAndStaleRisks.recommendedHandling: Use `hallveberg` in section IDs based on current displayed source text; store Hedvigsberg as an alias/source spelling.

sourceContradictionsAndStaleRisks.details: Stages 1, 3, 4, 5, and 8 require track ordering review; Stage 6 is reversed relative to official stage order.
sourceContradictionsAndStaleRisks.risk: High for geometry import if raw GPX is ingested without preprocessing.
sourceContradictionsAndStaleRisks.recommendedHandling: Do per-section geometry synthesis before import; mark raw multi-track files as planning-grade until corrected.

sourceContradictionsAndStaleRisks.details: The official maintainer page includes cabin, water, and toilet notes, but water reliability and toilet condition can change seasonally and through renovation projects.
sourceContradictionsAndStaleRisks.recommendedHandling: Verify cabin object pages and recent field reports in each section file; mark uncertain water as unreliable or pending.

sourceContradictionsAndStaleRisks.details: Naturkartan current notices are page-specific and may change seasonally.
sourceContradictionsAndStaleRisks.recommendedHandling: Record accessed dates and avoid presenting old notices as permanent closure rules.
